$comment: The Radix surface this kit intends to match, one entry per behaviour.
A behaviour counts as MATCHED only when a spec exercises it and every
observation in that spec agrees with Radix. Behaviours with no spec are
reported as UNCOVERED — the catalogue is the denominator, so adding a
component here lowers the score until the work is actually done.

behaviours.focus-on-click: clicking moves focus to the control
behaviours.disabled-blur: clicking a disabled control drops focus
behaviours.aria-pressed: pressed state is exposed as aria-pressed

behaviours.pointer-toggle: clicking the trigger opens and closes
behaviours.keyboard-toggle: Enter and Space toggle while the trigger is focused
behaviours.state-attr: root, trigger and content all carry the state
behaviours.wrapper-role: the root carries no ARIA role of its own

behaviours.indeterminate: the mixed state is exposed as aria-checked=mixed
behaviours.indeterminate-clears: activating from mixed goes to checked

behaviours.pointer-select: clicking an item selects it and deselects the rest
behaviours.roving-focus: only the selected item is in the tab order
behaviours.arrow-next: ArrowDown/ArrowRight moves selection to the next item
behaviours.arrow-prev: ArrowUp/ArrowLeft moves selection to the previous item
behaviours.arrow-wraps: arrow movement wraps at the ends
behaviours.group-role: the root exposes the radiogroup role
behaviours.disabled-skipped: a disabled item is skipped by arrow movement

arrow-selects.note: selection follows arrow focus, per the WAI-ARIA radio pattern
arrow-selects.disputed: The reference does not do this consistently. Measured on @radix-ui/react-radio-group in Chromium, settled two frames AND 500ms: the first two arrow presses after a pointer click move focus without moving selection, and every press after that moves both. Reproduced with a 2-item and a 3-item group, and with the React root on #root and on document.body. Until it is decided whether to follow the spec or the reference, this stays uncovered rather than being scored either way.

behaviours.arrow-next: ArrowRight moves to the next tab
behaviours.arrow-prev: ArrowLeft moves to the previous tab
behaviours.arrow-wraps: arrow movement wraps at the ends
behaviours.panel-swap: only the active tab's panel is reachable
behaviours.list-role: the list exposes tablist and items expose tab
behaviours.disabled-skipped: a disabled tab is skipped by arrow movement

behaviours.single-open: opening one item closes the previously open one
behaviours.pointer-toggle: clicking a header toggles its item

behaviours.switch-role: the control exposes the switch role

behaviours.keyboard-open: Enter on the trigger opens it
behaviours.focus-into: opening moves focus into the dialog
behaviours.focus-restore: closing returns focus to the trigger
behaviours.aria-expanded: the trigger says whether it is showing
behaviours.background-hidden: everything outside is out of the accessibility tree
behaviours.content-unmounted: closed content is not in the tree at all

focus-trap.note: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the open dialog
focus-trap.disputed: No spec can prove this yet: the harness has no Tab step, and UiHost has no document-order focus model to answer one with. Catalogued so the gap is counted rather than assumed away — see PLAN.md.

behaviours.no-role: a label carries no ARIA role of its own
behaviours.renders-text: its text is present and visible

behaviours.decorative-drops-role: a decorative separator reports no role at all
behaviours.orientation: vertical and horizontal both lay out

behaviours.state-loading: a value below the maximum reads as loading
behaviours.state-indeterminate: no value at all reads as indeterminate
behaviours.indicator: the indicator carries the same state

behaviours.no-role: pure layout: nothing in it carries a role
behaviours.ratio-applied: the inner box takes the declared ratio

behaviours.button-role: the control around the icon is a button
behaviours.label-names-it: the hidden label is its accessible name
behaviours.glyph-hidden: the glyph is decoration and does not reach the name

behaviours.no-role: neither the root nor the fallback carries a role
behaviours.fallback-shown: with no image the fallback is what is there

behaviours.radiogroup-role: a single-select group IS a radio group
behaviours.pointer-select: clicking an item selects it and deselects the rest
behaviours.roving-focus: exactly one item is a tab stop
behaviours.arrow-next: arrows move focus to the next item
behaviours.arrow-wraps: arrow movement wraps at the ends

behaviours.toolbar-role: the root exposes the toolbar role
behaviours.roving-focus: exactly one button is a tab stop
behaviours.arrow-next: ArrowRight moves focus to the next button
behaviours.arrow-wraps: arrow movement wraps at the ends

behaviours.alertdialog-role: the content is an alertdialog, not a dialog
behaviours.focus-cancel: opening moves focus to Cancel, not to the destructive action
behaviours.focus-restore: closing returns focus to the trigger
behaviours.background-hidden: everything outside is out of the accessibility tree
behaviours.content-unmounted: closed content is not in the tree at all

behaviours.pointer-close: clicking the open trigger closes it again
behaviours.not-modal: the page behind stays in the accessibility tree
behaviours.focus-into: opening moves focus to the first focusable node inside
behaviours.focus-restore: closing returns focus to the trigger
behaviours.aria-expanded: the trigger says whether it is showing
behaviours.content-unmounted: closed content is not in the tree at all

behaviours.hover-opens: the pointer arriving on the trigger opens it
behaviours.tooltip-role: the content carries the tooltip role
behaviours.escape-closes: Escape closes it and leaves focus alone
behaviours.content-unmounted: a closed tip is not in the tree at all

behaviours.hover-opens: the pointer arriving on the trigger opens it
behaviours.link-trigger: the trigger is a link, not a button
behaviours.content-no-role: the card itself carries no role
behaviours.content-unmounted: a closed card is not in the tree at all

behaviours.menu-role: the surface is a menu and its children are menuitems
behaviours.focus-content: opening focuses the surface, not the first item
behaviours.arrow-first: ArrowDown from the surface focuses the first item
behaviours.arrow-last: ArrowUp from the surface focuses the last item
behaviours.no-wrap: arrows stop at the ends rather than wrapping
behaviours.item-closes: activating an item closes the menu
behaviours.focus-restore: closing returns focus to the trigger
behaviours.background-hidden: everything outside is out of the accessibility tree
behaviours.content-unmounted: a closed menu is not in the tree at all

behaviours.secondary-open: the secondary pointer button opens it
behaviours.trigger-no-role: the trigger has no role and no name
behaviours.menu-role: the surface is a menu and its children are menuitems
behaviours.focus-content: opening focuses the surface, not the first item
behaviours.arrow-steps: arrows step between items, skipping disabled ones
behaviours.focus-lost: closing leaves focus nowhere, because the trigger cannot take it
behaviours.background-hidden: everything outside is out of the accessibility tree

behaviours.slider-role: the thumb is the slider, and the only tab stop
behaviours.value-reported: the position and the range are announced as numbers
behaviours.arrow-increment: Right and Up add a step
behaviours.arrow-decrement: Left and Down subtract a step
behaviours.home-end: Home goes to the minimum and End to the maximum
behaviours.clamped: the value never leaves the range
behaviours.disabled-inert: a disabled slider takes neither focus nor keys
behaviours.pointer-jump: pressing the track moves the value to that point
behaviours.pointer-drag: holding and moving keeps the value under the cursor
behaviours.drag-clamped: dragging past an end stops at it
behaviours.pointer-focuses-thumb: a press on the rail focuses the thumb, not the rail
behaviours.step-snapped: a dragged value lands on the step grid

behaviours.no-focus-steal: raising one does not move focus
behaviours.tab-reachable: the raised toast is a tab stop
behaviours.focus-viewport: dismissing moves focus to the viewport
behaviours.content-unmounted: an unraised toast is not in the tree at all

sortable.$comment: Not Radix — Radix has no sortable. ReUI's, and every shadcn-family one, is dnd-kit underneath, so dnd-kit is the oracle.

behaviours.sortable-roledescription: every item says it is sortable, so a reader learns the affordance
behaviours.sortable-pointer-reorder: dragging an item onto another reorders the list on release
behaviours.sortable-keyboard-pickup: Space picks the focused item up
behaviours.sortable-keyboard-move: arrows move the picked-up item between positions
behaviours.sortable-keyboard-drop: Space drops it where it now is
behaviours.sortable-escape-cancels: Escape puts it back and reorders nothing
behaviours.sortable-announces: every stage is announced into a live region
